title: The Properties menu puts a clip back the way it came in
goal: The three dot menu on the Properties heading of a video should offer Reset to defaults, as the video mock draws it, so one click takes a clip or title back to where it started: no keys, full opacity, its original place and size.
notes: Found building the-dock-headers-match-the-mock-small-caps-title (2026-09-27). The menu exists now (PropertiesPanelMenu in Sources/Photonz/PropertyKeysInspector.swift) with Copy Look and Paste Look, the app names for what the mock calls Copy properties. Reset to defaults has no action behind it yet: needs a pure PhotonzCore rule for what a layer kind resets to (keys cleared via PropertyKeys, transform and opacity defaults) under History.perform, TDD. Walk to extend: Scripts/playtest/dock-headers-walk.json (panelMenu "Properties Menu").
acceptance: The Properties menu on a video lists Reset to defaults under the copy row, as video.html #propMenu draws it
Choosing it on a keyed title leaves nothing animating and its position, size, rotation and opacity back at their starting values, in one undo
A walk at Next defaults chooses it from the menu and reads the result
